description: Election Commission - H. A. C. N. Gunarathna was elected as the member of the Alawwa Pradeshiya Sabaha
categorisation: This gazette content deals specifically with filling vacancies in a local government authority (Alawwa Pradeshiya Sabha) under the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance. It involves the electoral process for local government positions, including declarations of elected members to fill vacancies caused by failure to attend meetings and death. The content falls under election-related administrative matters rather than government personnel changes or structural reorganizations.
